summary_en: Daido Steel (5471) completed public tender offer for Tohoku Special Steel (5484) common shares at ¥4,491/share over 31 business days (18 May – 29 June 2026). 1,753,204 shares acquired. Tohoku becomes Daido consolidated subsidiary effective 6 July 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Public Tender Offer for Tohoku Special Steel Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 5484) and Changes in Subsidiaries
translation_en_brief: Daido Steel Co., Ltd. (5471, Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime) completed a public tender offer for all common shares of Tohoku Special Steel Co., Ltd. (5484, TSE Standard market), resolving to proceed at a board meeting on 15 May 2026. The tender offer ran from 18 May to 29 June 2026 (31 business days) at a price of ¥4,491 per share. No upper or lower acceptance thresholds were set; all tendered shares were acquired. A total of 1,753,204 shares were purchased, representing the entire float after deducting Daido's existing 2,549,500-share position and non-tendering agreements with major shareholders (Okaya Steel, Tokyo Kiln, and other investors holding 2,942,200 shares combined). Settlement begins 6 July 2026, upon which Tohoku becomes a consolidated subsidiary of Daido. The deal consolidates two Japanese specialty steel producers into a single corporate structure.
